offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly), the driver of Car 31 (Esteban Ocon), a team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence and determined that it was a first lap racing incident. Both cars recognised and accepted this as such. In the circumstances, we took no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 31 Incident With Car 10
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
